# telnyx_voice_channel_zones (Data Source)

Lists voice channel zones, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_voice_channel_zone`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `voice_channel_zones` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--voice_channel_zones))

<a id="nestedatt--voice_channel_zones"></a>
### Nested Schema for `voice_channel_zones`

Read-Only:

- `channels` (Number)
- `countries` (List of String) List of countries (in ISO 3166-2, capitalized) members of the billing channel zone
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date of when the channel zone was created
- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `record_type` (String)
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date of when the channel zone was updated
